files_modified.reason: Define RawImportFact, RawCallFact, and updated GraphEdge schema with resolutionStatus.
Update AST traversal to extract aliases, receivers, scope paths, and language-specific metadata.
Refactor buildGraph to implement the resolution pass and bind raw facts to canonical IDs.
Clean up or refactor legacy resolution heuristics in favor of the new pipeline-native resolvers.
Align ElementData fields with the new relationship fact/edge structure.

files_created.purpose: New service to encapsulate import and call resolution logic (uncertain - flag for plan author).

risks.description: Cross-language resolution complexity (TS vs Python vs Go scoping rules).
risks.mitigation: Focus on TypeScript first to satisfy Phase 0 ground-truth; follow language-specific resolution patterns sequentially.

risks.description: Ambiguity in obj.method() calls without full type inference.
risks.mitigation: Explicitly implement 'ambiguous' status with candidate IDs as per Phase 0 contract.

risks.description: Performance regression from additional resolution pass.
risks.mitigation: Maintain single-pass AST traversal; use optimized symbol lookup indexes in the resolution pass.

decision_records.decision: Introduce explicit RawImportFact and RawCallFact interfaces.
decision_records.rationale: Clear separation between scanner observations and inference results prevents early-binding bugs.

decision_records.decision: Restore Phase 0 ground-truth tests as the primary verification signal.
decision_records.rationale: Phase 1 erroneously reported these as missing; they are present and define the core contract for this phase.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires resolved import and call edges to use graph node IDs as endpoints
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: Resolution pass will bind raw module/symbol names to canonical codeRefId and use these as edge source/target.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires unresolved imports and calls to be explicit graph facts
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: Orchestrator will emit edges with resolutionStatus: 'unresolved' when resolution fails, preserving metadata for auditing.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires duplicate function name calls to be marked ambiguous with candidate IDs
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: Call resolver will detect multiple potential targets and return 'ambiguous' status with candidates array.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires alias imports to bind the local alias back to the exported source symbol
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: Import resolver will build local name-to-target mappings, accounting for 'as' aliases in raw facts.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires nested functions and class method calls to preserve qualified context
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: RelationshipExtractor will capture scopePath (e.g., 'Class.method') in raw facts for precise symbol matching.

ground_truth_test_mapping.test_assertion: requires graph validation to distinguish resolved, unresolved, and ambiguous edges
ground_truth_test_mapping.phase_2_change_that_satisfies_it: Every graph edge will carry a mandatory resolutionStatus field from the resolver.
